name: hairness/artifacts
description: The generic lifecycle for inspectable Workspace-owned Artifacts and explicit projections.

capabilities.description: Create, inspect, validate and promote Workspace-owned Artifacts.

skills.description: Use when work should become an explicit, inspectable Artifact.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create an Artifact, optionally importing a directory.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List Workspace Artifacts, legacy roots and Target projections.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate one Artifact against its owning kind.

commands.name: promote
commands.description: Promote a Workspace Artifact to a Home Workspace or Target.

commands.name: publish
commands.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for Artifact promotion.
